headline: Like ‘family businesses’: Inside the Nvidia board that ousted and rehired Jensen Huang
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang gushed last year that support from longtime board members Tench Coxe, Mark Stevens and Harvey Jones was crucial to helping him navigate three decades of running the company.
imageCaption: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has come to rely on the company's board, many members of which have served for decades.
paragraphs: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang gushed last year that support from longtime board members Tench Coxe, Mark Stevens and Harvey Jones was crucial to helping him navigate three decades of running the company.
“They not one time gave up on the company and us,” Huang told the Acquired podcast of the board members and other early employees.

Those same supporters have now helped see Huang through his biggest challenge yet — restoring his role as CEO following an unprecedented corporate scandal. But their close relationships have also raised questions about the board’s independence and whether it was equipped to hold Huang accountable and protect shareholders’ interests.

Including Huang, nearly half of Nvidia’s 11-person board has been with the company since its early days. Its three longest-serving members — Coxe, Stevens and Jones — saw the value of their combined holdings in the company jump by nearly $2.5 billion from Friday to Monday, after Huang was brought back.
